profile.headline: Software Engineering
profile.summary:
I am an experienced full-stack developer with a strong interest in user experience, software architecture, and programming language design.

I have worked on projects of all sizes and strive to design software that is usable, extensible, and maintainable.  I am strong in Javascript and Java and have a history using C and Perl. My current work involves covers a wide range from Slack and web applications to analytics.

I have experience with a lot of libraries and tools for Java and JavaScript, such as Spring, Apache, Express, MongDB, and related projects. Even in personal projects, I make use of things like RabbitMQ and redis. I'm always interested in what comes next, so I spend a lot of my free time playing around with new tools and technologies and keeping up with software development trends.

My personal projects use node.js, TypeScript, and Python. I've written native applications for both iOS and Android and a number of hybrid applications using Cordova and Ionic. Some of my more recent personal projects include a cross-platform chat client using Electron, conversational interfaces for Slack, and a MMO-style text adventure that runs as Discord and Slack bots.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Quip
positions.description:
* On the Executive Immersion team, developed multimodal presentations that integrated emerging technology and the Salesforce platform using Apple TV, Apple Watch, iPhone, and web applications.
* Designed a new development and runtime framework to allow said presentations to be developed rapidly. Framework was built around reusable components that integrated with external services such as Twilio and Cloudinary. An Ionic mobile framework was also built that allowed rapid prototyping mobile prototyping by loading applications remotely. Kinetic was presented to a number of executive clients at 2018 Dreamforce.
* As part of Futures Lab, designed and implemented a new presentation system based on Salesforce, Heroku, and Electron for the Decision Making project. Presentations are built in Salesforce and displayed on multiple devices using an Electron-based application and mobile app. Message routing and Salesforce API is handled by a Heroku application. Decision Making was presented at 2019 Dreamforce.
* As part of Ignite, designed and led a team of developers in the creation of Flex, an evolution of the Decision Making system that took user feedback into account and added features such as scene transitions, user interaction support, and voice control. Flex is designed for security, quick onboarding, scalability, and a "virtual-first" presentation model. The custom message handling was replaced with RabbitMQ.
* Part of a team that developed a number of Slack integrations for interfacing with Salesforce and rendering data. Applications included time tracking, analytics charts, and document processing. One project envisioned Slack as the central collaboration point, by integrating with tools such as Quip, Figma, and Miro, and providing a central location to discuss work streams.
* Experimented with a number of technologies, such as 3-D printing, IOT, computer vision, robotics, voice and gesture interfaces, and augmented reality.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
* Technical lead for the iMeet desktop application.  iMeet is a collaborative tool that provides contacts, individual and team messaging, and video conferencing.  The desktop application is built with HTML and jQuery and runs in a NW.js container.
* Investigated new technologies and collaborated with other project leads on architecture and design decisions.
* Investigated and fixed production and test issues.
* Implemented new features in the product.
* Performed administrative tasks such as investigating production issues and tracking overall sprint status.
* Improved code quality by implementing coding standards and updating the tooling, including a move to a gulp-based build and updating the CI process.
* Led research and development into new collaboration product based on Angular 2 and Electron.  Application is being designed as a responsive web application for both desktop and web usage.
* Lead engineer on technology research team, tasked with investigating advancements and innovations for PGi products.
* Integrated SiriKit control into our iOS application, applying the VOIP domain to start your own meeting or join a contact's meeting.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Lead software engineer on the front end of Bill Pay product.  Bill Pay is a web application that is used by client financial institutions.  End users are redirected to the application from their respective institution.  The application is a combination of Spring and Velocity in the server and Ext.js in the client.  Data is retrieved from the server via AJAX and the application page is dynamically generated.
* Monitored issues and work and assigned tasks to team members as needed.
* Mentored team members on process, tools, and standards.
* Worked on improving code quality and reliability by implementing standard tools and processes for development.

positions.title: Research Scientist II
positions.description:
* Developed a web-based, secure file storage application using modern web technologies along with a secure mail solution that takes uses the file storage system for attachment support.  Both applications were developed using Angular, Bootstrap, RequireJS, and LESS with a Java/Jersey backend and Oracle database.  The mail application communicate with several other applications using JMS to provide message scanning and communicates with other applications for message search and filtering using RESTful APIs.
* Rearchitected a number of existing components to bring them up to date on standards and tooling.
* Created Angular components for integrating with web services and jQuery plugins.
* Implemented graphics designer vision with Angular directives, Javascript, and CSS.
* Designed and implemented a number of back end APIs for communicating with external services and handling service requests using RESTful and JMS interfaces.
* Designed and implemented services for accessing SQL databases, including H2 and Oracle.
* Performed software development lifecycle activities, including requirements discussion, design, implementation, and code reviews using Agile methodologies.

positions.title: Independent Contractor
positions.description:
* Worked on a project for creating a domain-specific language for describing over-the-air messages.
* Implemented a compiler and tools for converting the domain-specific language into other languages, such as C and Java.
* Maintained build system for the language ecosystem.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Worked directly with and provided tier 2/3 support for on-site customer representatives to help customers with issues and provide timely resolution.
* Developed an object-oriented, CGI-based Perl interface for the FlexNet system.  This interface allowed users to view meter and network analytics, examine the details of individual meters, and send commands to meters and receive responses.
* Converted the Perl application to Java, using Tomcat, Struts2, and Spring as the primary backend frameworks.  The frontend was a combination of hand-coded JavaScript and usage of the YUI framework.  A number of enhancements were made to the system, including additional charting using JFreeChart, a switch to JMS-based SOA using Apache ActiveMQ and Camel, and a responsive web interface using AJAX-based polling.  The conversion was received positively by customers and the move to Java allowed us to use more current technologies and take advantage of a larger developer base.
* Transitioned the web application away from hand-coded SQL calls to using Hibernate entities and generated SQL, and stored procedures.
* Moved the Java tools from storing dependencies in subversion into a Maven repository and changed their tooling to use maven, allowing us to easily change dependencies and reorganize the source code repository.
* Administered the build system, which provided automated, continuous integration using subversion and Jenkins.  Wrote a number of support tools for administering the system in Perl.
* Researched SDLC improvements and implemented a number of tools for improving efficiency, including a common Eclipse runtime, immediate feedback on build issues, Bugzilla improvements, and usage of the Crucible tool for code reviews.
* Designed and implemented a template system for describing over-the-air messages and generating Java, C, and supporting documentation from them.
* Helped design the SOA architecture and implemented portions of the transition to it.

positions.title: Senior Analyst
positions.description:
* Performed software development lifecycle activities, including discussing requirements with clients, estimating project timelines, project development, testing, and deployment.
* Designed and developed Perl applications that automate many tasks in the telecommunications field, saving data and settings in Oracle tables and screen-scraping TN3270 host sessions. SQL and schema design were heavily used in the design and development process.
* Designed and developed a library of object-oriented Perl modules that could be used by any application. These modules simplified TN3270 screen-scraping and application configuration.
* Maintained installations of Apache HTTPD, Perl, mod_perl, and other unix utilities.
* Designed and developed web browser-based applications, usually using Apache HTTPD and mod_perl. Applications were designed to conform to W3C standards.
* Designed and developed next generation mechanization software in Java, using J2EE, Hibernate, and TIRKS jX.
* Mentored and trained other developers in using Perl, Java, standard libraries and tools, such as Eclipse, Hibernate, CVS, and DBI.

positions.title: Software Professional
positions.description: * Designed, developed, and tested enhancements for US Navy aircraft navigational software using Ada.

positions.title: Technical Programmer
positions.description:
* Developed applications and tools for C-SPAN's Public Affairs Video Archives using C, C++, Perl, and the KMAN database language.
* Developed applications which generated web pages by querying the television program database and exporting the information. These applications included a catalog for ordering video tapes, a site to examine archived information and to request research, and C-SPAN’s Yahoo store.
* Wrote software to automate label printing and barcode scanning.  Perl, C, and KMAN were used to generate Postscript files for invoices and tape labels.

projects.title: GitBoard/Collab: Virtual whiteboard with branch and merge support
projects.description:
GitBoard/Collab is a virtual whiteboard that adds additional collaboration modes to the normal concept of a whiteboard.  In addition to normal tooling, GitBoard provides
* Multiple layers per board
* The ability to share boards with others
* The ability to "fork" a board to work on it separately and then merge changes back in
* Chat functionality between people working on the same board

projects.title: GT Class: a mobile interface for GeorgiaTech's classroom management software
projects.description: GT Class is a mobile interface that is designed to help students keep track of assignments and announcements posted with GeorgiaTech classroom management software, T-Square.  GT Class is an Ionic-based application with accompanying PHP backend.  It allows users to download their class information, add assignment due dates to their native calendar, and receive notifications when new items have been posted.
